codeSnippets.output: Zebra stripes on odd rows plus a purple arrow before every item.
A visible outline only for keyboard/assistive focus, not mouse clicks.

exercise.instruction: Style the list: give odd list items (li:nth-child(odd)) a background of #eef2ff, add a ::before with content "> " and color #6d28d9 to every li, and make the button text turn blue with a :hover rule.

hints: Hint 1: li:nth-child(odd) { background: #eef2ff; } stripes every other row.
Hint 2: li::before { content: '> '; color: #6d28d9; } — content is mandatory.
Hint 3: .btn:hover { color: #2563eb; } gives a clear interactive signal.

quiz.question: What is the difference between :focus and :focus-visible?
options: :focus-visible only matches keyboard or assistive focus

quiz.question: ::before creates content...
options: inside the element after its children
at the start of the element — but only renders when content is set
as a separate element in the DOM
